meta.title: Libraries Master Issue Tensor — Combined Claude Opus 4.6 + GPT-5.4
meta.note: Both audits inspected the same archive. GPT-5.4 had access to the full 30-crate workspace; Claude inspected the Recall-visible surface (vendored deps + import boundaries).

axes.Truth: repo truth, support-claim clarity, and narrative consistency
axes.Runtime: execution semantics, failure behavior, and blast radius
axes.Governance: governance authority, constitutional enforcement, scope gating
axes.Ops: release gates, reproducibility, and operator discipline
axes.Scale: hotspots, growth pressure, and performance evidence
axes.Security: capability control, approval enforcement, and misuse resistance
axes.Human: maintainer load, onboarding pain, and cognitive surface
